Questions
COMMON questions.
Correct. When Strict Mode is on, force-closing the app won't work. The alarm re-triggers until the mission is completed. There is no backdoor.
The alarm continues or escalates. Your streak resets. You're prompted to retry or adjust difficulty. The system doesn't reward failure but it does let you learn from it.
The app uses your phone's camera or motion sensors to count and verify reps. You need to be in frame or position the device correctly. Setup instructions walk you through it on first use.
Yes. Each alarm has its own mission, schedule, and difficulty. Math challenges on weekdays, physical missions on weekends — or fully custom per day.
Streak protection is available on paid plans. It gives you a limited number of grace days per month — for illness or travel — without fully resetting your progress.
The free tier gives you 1 alarm and 3 mission types. Paid plans start at $1.99/week and unlock everything — unlimited alarms, full mission library, Strict Mode, and advanced analytics.
